title: What Do You Usually Do on the Weekend?
synopsis: Lili, Ben, Lucy, and Little Yan discuss plans for the weekend.

fullText.simplified:
周末你们一般做什么？

丽丽：嗨，露西，小言，我们在这里。
露西：嗨，丽丽！
小言：本，你看起来很开心！有什么好事情吗？
本：是啊！因为我有女朋友了！
小言：真的吗？谁是你的女朋友？
露西：当然是丽丽啦！
小言：你们两个在一起了？
丽丽：嗯……
小言：恭喜你啊，本！
露西：明天是周六了。周末，你们一般做什么？
丽丽：我周末一般会去健身房运动，或者去咖啡馆、书店看书。因为做运动让我更健康，看书让我更聪明。你呢？
露西：我，当然是逛街啦！逛街总是让我很开心！北京那么大，很多地方我还没有去过呢！小言，你呢？
小言：我喜欢去风景好的地方拍照片或者拍视频。我也喜欢唱卡拉OK。但是我不喜欢逛街买东西，我在台湾的时候，我妈妈总是让我和她去逛街。我觉得买东西很无聊，所以我现在很少逛街。我一年最多逛五次。
本：我和小言一样，我也不喜欢逛街，我觉得逛街要花很多钱。我喜欢户外活动，比如，爬山、攀岩、露营。
小言：你常常露营吗？我还没有露营过呢。
本：对啊！我在美国的时候，一个月至少爬一次山，一年露营四次左右。
丽丽：你还喜欢在家打游戏。你一个星期至少打五次游戏。然后，每次至少打一个小时左右。
本：男生都喜欢打游戏啦！小言也喜欢啊！
小言：对，我也特别喜欢打游戏。有时候我一天打三次游戏。打游戏总是让我很开心。
露西：那明天你们打算做什么？
丽丽：我打算去健身房做运动。因为我这个星期很忙，只去了两次。所以我想周末的时候去健身。我让本和我一起去健身房，可是他不想去。
本：我不想去健身房，因为明天我想去爬山。天气预报说，明天是晴天，没有风也没有雨，不冷也不热。北京有很多漂亮的山。小言，露西，你们觉得呢？
小言：我同意！我觉得爬山是个很好的想法。山上的风景特别好，我可以拍好看的照片。
露西：我不同意！我觉得爬山让我很累。我周末想休息，不想让自己很累。我更喜欢丽丽的想法，周末去健身房做瑜伽会让我很放松。
本：我不同意你和丽丽的想法。我觉得你们可以星期一到星期五去健身房。但是周末的时候，你们最好做一些户外活动。因为爬山的时候，你们会看到很多绿色，这对你们的眼睛好。还有，看美丽的风景也会让你们很放松。
丽丽：好吧，我觉得你说得对。露西，我们也和他们一起去爬山吧！
露西：嗯……因为爬山太累了，所以……如果爬山以后，我们一起去吃火锅，那么我就和你们一起去。
小言：你不要减肥了吗？
露西：爬山就是减肥啊！
小言：好，那我们周六早上8点先去爬山，然后再去吃火锅，最后来我家看电影。
本：太好了！

本：對啊！我在美國的時候，一個月至少爬一次山，一年露營四次左右。

露西：那明天你們打算做什麼？
麗麗：我打算去健身房做運動。因為我這個星期很忙，只去了兩次。所以我想週末的時候去健身。我讓本和我一起去健身房，可是他不想去。
本：我不想去健身房，因為明天我想去爬山。天氣預報說，明天是晴天，沒有風也沒有雨，不冷也不熱。北京有很多漂亮的山。小言，露西，你們覺得呢？
小言：我同意！我覺得爬山是個很好的想法。山上的風景特別好，我可以拍好看的照片。
露西：我不同意！我覺得爬山讓我很累。我週末想休息，不想讓自己很累。我更喜歡麗麗的想法，週末去健身房做瑜伽會讓我很放鬆。
本：我不同意你和麗麗的想法。我覺得你們可以星期一到星期五去健身房。但是週末的時候，你們最好做一些戶外活動。因為爬山的時候，你們會看到很多綠色，這對你們的眼睛好。還有，看美麗的風景也會讓你們很放鬆。
麗麗：好吧，我覺得你說得對。露西，我們也和他們一起去爬山吧！
露西：嗯……因為爬山太累了，所以……如果爬山以後，我們一起去吃火鍋，那麼我就和你們一起去。
小言：你不要減肥了嗎？
露西：爬山就是減肥啊！
小言：好，那我們週六早上8點先去爬山，然後再去吃火鍋，最後來我家看電影。
本：太好了！

sentences.pinyin: shān shàng de fēng jǐng tè bié hǎo wǒ kě yǐ pāi hǎo kàn de zhào piàn
sentences.english: Little Yan: I agree, I think that going hiking is a really good idea.
The scenery in the mountains is especially good. I can take some beautiful photos.

sentences.simplified: 露西：我不同意！我觉得爬山让我很累。我周末想休息，不想让自己很累。
sentences.traditional: 露西：我不同意！我覺得爬山讓我很累。我週末想休息，不想讓自己很累。
sentences.pinyin: lù xī wǒ bù tóng yì wǒ jué de pá shān ràng wǒ hěn lèi wǒ zhōu mò xiǎng xiū xi bù xiǎng ràng zì jǐ hěn lèi

sentences.simplified: 我更喜欢丽丽的想法，周末去健身房做瑜伽会让我很放松。
sentences.traditional: 我更喜歡麗麗的想法，週末去健身房做瑜伽會讓我很放鬆。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ gèng xǐ huan lì lì de xiǎng fǎ zhōu mò qù jiàn shēn fáng zuò yú jiā huì ràng wǒ hěn fàng sōng
sentences.english: Lucy: I disagree! Hiking makes me really tired. I want to rest this weekend; I don’t want to make myself tired.
I like Lili’s idea more; going to the gym this weekend to do yoga would make me very relaxed.

sentences.simplified: 本：我不同意你和丽丽的想法。我觉得你们可以星期一到星期五去健身房。
sentences.traditional: 本：我不同意你和麗麗的想法。我覺得你們可以星期一到星期五去健身房。
sentences.pinyin: běn wǒ bù tóng yì nǐ hé lì lì de xiǎng fǎ wǒ jué de nǐ men kě yǐ xīng qī yī dào xīng qī wǔ qù jiàn shēn fáng

sentences.simplified: 但是周末的时候，你们最好做一些户外活动。
sentences.traditional: 但是週末的時候，你們最好做一些戶外活動。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì zhōu mò de shí hou nǐ men zuì hǎo zuò yì xiē hù wài huó dòng
sentences.english: Ben: I don’t agree with you and Lili. I think that you guys can go to the gym from Monday to Friday.

sentences.simplified: 因为爬山的时候，你们会看到很多绿色，这对你们的眼睛好。
sentences.traditional: 因為爬山的時候，你們會看到很多綠色，這對你們的眼睛好。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi pá shān de shí hou nǐ men huì kàn dào hěn duō lǜ sè zhè duì nǐ men de yǎn jing hǎo
sentences.english: But on the weekend, it’s best for you to do some outdoor activities.

sentences.simplified: 还有，看美丽的风景也会让你们很放松。
sentences.traditional: 還有，看美麗的風景也會讓你們很放鬆。
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu kàn měi lì de fēng jǐng yě huì ràng nǐ men hěn fàng sōng
sentences.english: Because when you’re hiking, you will see a lot of green, which is good for your eyes.
What’s more, seeing beautiful scenery will also make you feel very relaxed.

sentences.simplified: 丽丽：好吧，我觉得你说得对。露西，我们也和他们一起去爬山吧！
sentences.traditional: 麗麗：好吧，我覺得你說得對。露西，我們也和他們一起去爬山吧！
sentences.pinyin: lì lì hǎo ba wǒ jué de nǐ shuō de duì lù xī wǒ men yě hé tā men yì qǐ qù pá shān ba

sentences.english: Lili: Fine, I think you’re right. Lucy, let’s go hiking with them!

sentences.simplified: 露西：嗯……因为爬山太累了，所以……如果爬山以后，我们一起去吃火锅，那么我就和你们一起去。
sentences.traditional: 露西：嗯……因為爬山太累了，所以……如果爬山以後，我們一起去吃火鍋，那麼我就和你們一起去。
sentences.pinyin: lù xī en yīn wèi pá shān tài lèi le suǒ yǐ rú guǒ pá shān yǐ hòu wǒ men yì qǐ qù chī huǒ guō nà me wǒ jiù hé nǐ men yì qǐ qù

sentences.english: Lucy: Okay … Since hiking is very tiring … If we go eat hotpot together after we go hiking, then I’ll go with you guys!

sentences.simplified: 小言：你不要减肥了吗？
sentences.traditional: 小言：你不要減肥了嗎？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yán nǐ bú yào jiǎn féi le ma

sentences.english: Little Yan: Aren’t you trying to lose weight?

sentences.simplified: 露西：爬山就是减肥啊！
sentences.traditional: 露西：爬山就是減肥啊！
sentences.pinyin: lù xī pá shān jiù shì jiǎn féi a

sentences.english: Lucy: Hiking is losing weight!

sentences.simplified: 小言：好，那我们周六早上8点先去爬山，然后再去吃火锅，
sentences.traditional: 小言：好，那我們週六早上8點先去爬山，然後再去吃火鍋，
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yán hǎo nà wǒ men zhōu liù zǎo shang 1 diǎn xiān qù pá shān rán hòu zài qù chī huǒ guō

sentences.simplified: 最后来我家看电影。
sentences.traditional: 最後來我家看電影。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu lái wǒ jiā kàn diàn yǐng
sentences.english: Little Yan: Okay, then on Saturday at 8 am we’ll first go hiking, and then we’ll go to eat hotpot.
Finally, everyone can come to my house to watch a movie!

sentences.simplified: 本：太好了！
sentences.traditional: 本：太好了！
sentences.pinyin: běn tài hǎo le

sentences.english: Ben: Perfect!

raw.synopsis: Lili, Ben, Lucy, and Little Yan discuss plans for the weekend.
sentence_translations: What Do You Usually Do on the Weekend?
Lili: Hey Lucy, Little Yan! We’re here!
Lucy: Hey Lili!
Little Yan: Ben, you seem really happy! Did something good happen?
Ben: Yeah! Because I have a girlfriend now!
Little Yan: Really? Who’s your girlfriend?
Lucy: Of course it’s Lili!
Little Yan: You two are together now?
Lili: Yeah …
Little Yan: Congratulations, Ben!
Lucy: Tomorrow is Saturday. What do you guys usually do on the weekend?
Lili: On the weekend, I usually go to the gym to exercise. Otherwise, I go to a cafe or bookstore to read.
Because exercising makes me healthier and reading makes me smarter. What about you?
Lucy: Me? Of course, I go shopping! Shopping always makes me very happy!
Beijing is huge. There are so many places I still haven’t been to yet! What about you, Little Yan?
Little Yan: I like to go to places with nice scenery to take photos or videos. I also like to sing karaoke.
But I don’t like going shopping. When I was in Taiwan, my mom always made me go shopping with her.
I think that buying stuff is boring, so I seldom go shopping. At most, I go shopping five times per year.
Ben: I’m the same as Little Yan. I also dislike shopping. I feel like shopping requires spending a lot of money.
I like doing outdoor activities, such as hiking, rock climbing, and camping.
Little Yan: Do you camp often? I haven’t been camping before.
Ben: Yeah! When I was in the US, I would go hiking at least once a month and go camping around four times per year.
Lili: You also like playing video games at home. You play games at least five times per week.
And each time, you play for at least an hour or so.
Ben: All guys like to play video games! Little Yan does too!
Little Yan: True, I also really like playing video games. Sometimes I play three times a day.
Playing games always makes me really happy.
Lucy: So what do you guys plan to do tomorrow?
Lili: I plan to go to the gym and exercise. Because I was really busy this week, I only went twice.
So I want to work out this weekend. I asked Ben to go to the gym with me, but he doesn’t want to go.
Ben: I don’t want to go to the gym because I want to go hiking tomorrow.
The weather forecast said that tomorrow is sunny, with no wind or rain. It will be neither hot nor cold.
Beijing has lots of beautiful mountains. Little Yan, Lucy, what do you guys think?
Little Yan: I agree, I think that going hiking is a really good idea.
The scenery in the mountains is especially good. I can take some beautiful photos.
Lucy: I disagree! Hiking makes me really tired. I want to rest this weekend; I don’t want to make myself tired.
I like Lili’s idea more; going to the gym this weekend to do yoga would make me very relaxed.
Ben: I don’t agree with you and Lili. I think that you guys can go to the gym from Monday to Friday.
But on the weekend, it’s best for you to do some outdoor activities.
Because when you’re hiking, you will see a lot of green, which is good for your eyes.
What’s more, seeing beautiful scenery will also make you feel very relaxed.
Lili: Fine, I think you’re right. Lucy, let’s go hiking with them!
Lucy: Okay … Since hiking is very tiring … If we go eat hotpot together after we go hiking, then I’ll go with you guys!
Little Yan: Aren’t you trying to lose weight?
Lucy: Hiking is losing weight!
Little Yan: Okay, then on Saturday at 8 am we’ll first go hiking, and then we’ll go to eat hotpot.
Finally, everyone can come to my house to watch a movie!
Ben: Perfect!
